findings.title: CURRENT_STATE.md did not record checkpoint 74 at all
findings.detail: Before this operation, knowledge/CURRENT_STATE.md named checkpoint 73 as the controlling checkpoint ('Last updated: 2026-08-07T02:20:00.000Z (COMMIT 5R1-C37 checkpoint 73 ...)') and contained ZERO occurrences of 'checkpoint 74'. CP74's documentationCutover block records beforeSha256 f53cf577... and afterSha256 70c96a60..., which is the CP73 cutover already reflected in the file; CP74 did not itself amend CURRENT_STATE.md.
findings.consequence: The mission precondition 'clearly identify Checkpoint 74 as the current controlling state only if verified' could not be satisfied from the document as found. Checkpoint 74's own content IS verified; only its reflection in CURRENT_STATE.md was missing.
findings.remediation: The checkpoint-75 CURRENT_STATE.md update records checkpoint 74 explicitly and supersedes it with checkpoint 75.

findings.title: CP74 beforeSha256 is correct but collides with an untracked duplicate
findings.detail: CP74 records documentationCutover.beforeSha256 = f53cf577c7b4a979b563f6a22b96b9f30164608a79de5054ead05c63016d6aa0. This value is CORRECT for HEAD:knowledge/CURRENT_STATE.md (122,561 bytes). It is ALSO the exact SHA-256 of the untracked file IDEA.md, which was verified byte-identical to HEAD:knowledge/CURRENT_STATE.md by cmp.
findings.initialSuspicionRecordedAndREFUTED: This hash was first suspected of being a mis-recorded IDEA.md hash. That suspicion was tested and REFUTED: the value is the genuine pre-cutover hash of the governed document. The collision is caused by duplication, not by an error in CP74.
findings.consequence: A reader matching this hash could bind it to the wrong file. Recorded so the ambiguity is explicit rather than latent.

findings.title: Concurrent third-party writer is not proven disabled
findings.detail: CP74 records concurrentWriterIncident.classification = THIRD_PARTY_UNGOVERNED_AGENT_SCAFFOLDING_WRITE_INTO_GOVERNED_REPOSITORY with mustBeStoppedByOwnerBeforeNextGovernedOperation = true. This operation verified quiescence only. No openclaw process was observed, but openclaw-workspace-state.json carries setupCompletedAt 2026-08-07T01:58:40.448Z — the same day as this operation and after CP73/CP74 remediation. Two hermes gateway processes (PIDs 21112 and 4472, profile tina-orchestrator) are RUNNING, though their last observed write into this repository was 2026-08-04.
findings.consequence: The CP74 precondition for the next governed operation is NOT satisfied. A completed one-shot initializer marker is not proof that future execution is disabled.

findings.title: Two governed source paths cannot exist in this working tree
findings.detail: tax-engines/CON/domain-config.js and tax-engines/CON/subclassifier.js carry skip-worktree bits under core.sparseCheckout=true because 'CON' is a reserved Windows device name. They are tracked at HEAD but can never be materialised on this filesystem.
findings.consequence: Any evidence process that reconstructs an index without preserving skip-worktree bits will report them as deletions. This is the direct cause of the 13,973-versus-13,975 arithmetic.
findings.recommendation: Owner should decide whether these two paths are still required; renaming them is a governed change and was NOT performed here.
